command: cd /home/agent/workspace && actual=$(sha256sum release/artifact.txt | awk '{print $1}') && stored=$(cat release/digest.txt) && mapped=$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(open('release/mapping.json'))['1.0.0'])") && echo "actual: $actual" && echo "stored: $stored" && echo "mapped: $mapped" && [ "$actual" = "$stored" ] && echo "digest.txt: MATCH" || echo "digest.txt: MISMATCH"; [ "$actual" = "$mapped" ] && echo "mapping.json: MATCH" || echo "mapping.json: MISMATCH"
intent: Recompute digest and verify against digest.txt and mapping.json
